params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch makes extensive changes that are unrelated to fixing the SonarQube warning about usage of deprecated code marked for removal. It replaces deprecated constructor calls for wrapper classes (e.g., new Integer(9)) with their valueOf() equivalents throughout the code, which is unrelated to the "@Deprecated" annotation issue described. There is no modification addressing the deprecated classes or methods marked for removal, nor any avoidance or removal of their usage. These changes, while possibly improvements for performance or style, do not address the specific warning and thus are unnecessary and unrelated modifications.
